title: Let service quiet the complaint
summary: Serving the True Guru receives Naam until peace has somewhere to live and complaint loses its claim on the mouth.
takeaway: Let service carry complaint into Naam.
lifeApplication: When irritation starts rehearsing its case, choose one act of service and let the Name answer the noise.

source.shortMeaning: Those who serve the True Guru receive Naam, and the mind's cries settle into peace and joy.
source.lifeApplication: When complaint rises, do not only analyze it; serve the Guru's way until remembrance has room to quiet it.

evidence.coreClaim: Those who serve the True Guru receive Naam, and the mind's cries settle into peace and joy.
evidence.turn: Service changes complaint by giving the mind a place to receive Naam instead of replaying injury.
evidence.practicalImplication: When irritation starts rehearsing its case, choose one act of service and let the Name answer the noise.
